summary: Renders a clipped 2D rectangle surface. When a10 >= 0 it derives the rectangle from the object's this+0x1C/this+0x20 dimensions scaled by a7/a8; otherwise it uses the raw float parameters directly. Coordinates are converted to integers via CRTFtol, negative offsets are folded back, the two corner pairs are normalized by sub_543540, and F_2DSurfaceCompositing composites the surface against the dword_8B78A0 target when the clipped width and height are positive, clearing the 0x400 flag on the target surface afterwards.

CRTFtol converts float coordinates and dimensions to integers on both paths.
Scale source dimension this+0x1C by a7 (and this+0x20 by a8) to produce the integer rectangle extent.
If first clipped coordinate v12 < 0 subtract it from a10; if second clipped coordinate v13 < 0 subtract it from a2.
sub_543540 clamps/normalizes the two rectangle corner pairs (&a10,&a2) and (&a4,&a6) against the extent (a3,a5).
Composite only when clipped width a3 > 0 and clipped height a5 > 0.
F_2DSurfaceCompositing(dword_8B78A0, this, ...) composites the surface, then clears the 0x400 flag on the target surface v10[6].
Return the compositing result, or the clipped width a3 when no compositing occurred.
